title: Vendor
description: One entry in data/engine/vendors.json: a merchant, what they stock and the caps they hold.

place.description: Location id where the vendor can be found.

caps.description: Caps the vendor holds and starts with.

stock.description: What the vendor starts with; an item appears once.

item.description: Item id (weapon, armor, ammo or consumable).

restock_days.description: Days between restocks: the vendor goes back to the stock and caps above on every multiple of this many days since the game began. When absent the game's default of 3 days applies.

repair.description: A repair service: the vendor mends weapons for caps, up to their own Repair skill.

skill.description: The vendor's Repair skill; a weapon is mended to at most this percent.

discount.description: A price cut for a player in good standing: the percent off what the player pays, while at least one of the conditions holds (always, when there are none).
